Comb duality therefore gives c^(-1)(comb_dual*fhat)(x)=c^(-1)Σfhat(x−λ*); no arbitrary distribution product or convolution is used. hI has c=h^n and dual h^(-1)Z^n, so the frequency periodization has h^(−n).
